_about: The numbers a run is compared with (docs/build-and-test-reference.md). Changes only with the maintainer's approval. Runs are headless, --rtc-seed 1, --max-seconds 600, on the final config. Counts only. The *_vmu runs attach a new memory card (a file that doesn't exist yet, so the program makes a blank, formatted one, as a player's first run does); the others attach none. linux_sandbox_speed_x is null where no Linux sandbox has made the run yet.
